summary: Iteration 2 fully tested. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (company/catalog CRUD, quotes list with effective_statut, DEV-2026-001 derived a_relancer, filter, two-phase AI analyze (questions then priced lines with source/catalog_code), status workflow with sent_at/next_relance_at/refused_at/accepted_at, mark-relance increments count and sets statut=relance, French relance message with full name and '1 093,40 € TTC' format, quote update persistence, dashboard stats). Frontend (Playwright): Dashboard, Settings (company + catalog + reset demo), Quotes list, QuoteDetail with relance-info + relance modal prefilled message ('Bonjour Mme Dubois... 1 093,40 € TTC...'), send-modal with delay-5/7/10 + confirm-send-btn transitions brouillon -> envoye with next relance date, New Quote wizard AI questions panel (4 questions returned), answers submit produces 6 priced lines with source badges (Catalogue · PROT-01, etc.), and 'Hypothèses IA' note. Wall surface correctly derived from answers (60 m² peinture murs, not the 32 m² floor area).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by the visual-editor dev wrapper injecting a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> elements when the value expression is a numeric literal like value={5.5}. Cosmetic only in preview but pollutes console; consider casting to string (value={String(v)}) or moving numeric options to constants to help the dev wrapper avoid instrumenting them.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress the <option><span> hydration warning by rendering TVA options with String(v) values so the dev-tools instrumentation does not insert a span child inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 640-line file — still manageable but nearing the split-threshold. Consider splitting into routers/quotes.py, routers/analyze.py, seed.py before next iteration.
AI JSON parsing uses a broad regex \{.*\} — resilient here but can trip on multi-object responses. Not currently an issue but worth logging raw response on JSONDecodeError.
compute_totals treats tva=None as 0 for TTC computation. That's the right default but the UI should make clear that 'À définir' lines are not counted in TVA total (currently they aren't, so OK).
In serialize_quote, the mongo _id is popped correctly. Good.
seed uses count>0 short-circuit; POST /api/seed correctly wipes first — good.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed was called (session-scoped pytest fixture). Also created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed brouillons via /api/quotes for status-workflow tests; DEV-2026-004 was sent (status transitioned to envoye) as part of the frontend send-flow check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~8s and covers all iteration-2 endpoints. Old iter1 file moved to backend_test_iter1.py.bak. Note: running the backend suite reseeds data (POST /api/seed) and then PUT /api/company flips is_demo=false; the demo badge in Settings will only show after another /api/seed call. AI analyze took ~5s for questions and ~10s for lines with gpt-5.4.
